item.text:
Continuation completed across chapters 1B–8B. No scores assigned.

The workspace remained unavailable (`bwrap: loopback: Failed RTM_NEWADDR`), so `research-ledger-manifest.json` could not be updated. The following globally unique records require parent-workflow insertion.

New defensible source-claim units:

- `WEB-R3-001` — Pakistan’s National Assembly act registry records the Official Secrets Amendment Act, Army Amendment Act, PEMRA Amendment Act, National Anti-Money Laundering Authority Act, Elections Amendment Act, and Board of Investment Amendment Act during 2023. This supplies primary legislative chronology for 3B, 4B, 5B, 7B, and 8B. Source: [National Assembly acts registry](https://na.gov.pk/en/acts-tenure.php?tenure_id=20), lines 216–218, 228, 231, 236, 256.  
  Methodology IDs: `3B.5`, `4B.4`, `4B.6`, `4B.9`, `5B.4`, `7B.6`, `8B.2`.

- `WEB-R3-002` — The official CERT Rules Gazette created national, sectoral, federal, provincial, critical-infrastructure, defence, and organizational cybersecurity structures, with incident-response and risk-management functions. This narrows the 1B.9 gap: Pakistan had a formal cybersecurity governance framework, though not a comprehensive AI, biological, or nuclear-dual-use regime. Source: [CERT Rules 2023 Gazette](https://pkcert.gov.pk/uploads/2023/10/GAZETTE-CERT-Rules-2023.pdf), pp. 2–7, especially lines 100–103, 120–146, 161–184, 245–274.  
  Methodology IDs: `1B.9`, `1B.3`.

- `WEB-R3-003` — The National Assembly registry records the 29 May 2023 National Accountability Amendment Act, confirming a target-period legal change to the accountability framework. The record alone does not establish that the amendment benefited Sharif or obstructed a case. Source: [National Assembly acts registry](https://na.gov.pk/en/acts-tenure.php?tenure_id=20), lines 256–257.  
  Methodology IDs: `7B.6`, `7B.7`.

- `WEB-R3-004` — The registry records the 4 August 2023 Sovereign Wealth Fund Act and Board of Investment Amendment Act, showing formal institutional machinery for investment and state-asset management was enacted immediately before the elected government ended. This is design evidence only; no project-level benefit or personal enrichment was established. Source: [National Assembly acts registry](https://na.gov.pk/en/acts-tenure.php?tenure_id=20), lines 231–236.  
  Methodology IDs: `5B.4`, `5B.5`, `7B.3`, `7B.9`, `8B.2`, `8B.5`.

- `WEB-R3-005` — The official BISP site announced FY2022–23 annual reports covering the National Socio-Economic Registry, education conditional cash transfers, and health/nutrition conditional cash transfers; it also reported support reaching 9.3 million households at Rs10,500 quarterly. These remain official program claims, not independent outcome verification. Source: [BISP annual-report announcement](https://bisp.gov.pk/NewsDetail/M2JhYmRkNTAtZTEzYi00YTZjLWEyMjEtOGVlOTJkMjgwOWVi).  
  Methodology IDs: `6B.1`, `6B.2`, `6B.3`, `6B.5`, `6B.7`, `6B.9`.

- `WEB-R3-006` — An ADB project page provides an auditable-project-financial-statements record for Pakistan’s Integrated Social Protection Development Program covering July 2022–June 2023. It establishes availability of external financial reporting but does not, without extracting the PDF, establish beneficiary outcomes or payment integrity. Source: [ADB audited project financial statements](https://www.adb.org/projects/documents/pak-45233-007-apfs-0).  
  Methodology IDs: `6B.5`, `6B.7`, `6B.9`.

- `WEB-R3-007` — Pakistan’s official SIFC reporting stated that its third Apex Committee meeting approved investment projects in agriculture/livestock, mining/minerals, IT, and energy and prepared foreign-investment outreach. This is direct evidence of project approval and institutional activity, but not completed investment or effectiveness. Source: [Government press release](https://pid.gov.pk/site/press_detail/23187).  
  Methodology IDs: `5B.4`, `5B.5`, `8B.2`, `8B.3`, `8B.6`.

- `WEB-R3-008` — The ECP’s official 2023 election page lists records concerning Punjab and KP elections, caretaker-government guidelines, election-date correspondence, and fresh delimitation after the 2023 census. This confirms a recoverable primary administrative record set, but the underlying documents require separate extraction before making narrower legal claims. Source: [ECP 2023 election records](https://ecp.gov.pk/general-elections-2023-2).  
  Methodology IDs: `4B.1`, `4B.4`, `4B.8`, `8B.5`, `8B.10`.

Chapter disposition:

- `1B`: Improved through primary CERT Rules; catastrophic-dual-use governance remains only partially evidenced.
- `2B`: Primary UNMOGIP and court material remains usable; no new independent Afghan-side sanctuary evidence was recovered.
- `3B`: Primary legislative chronology improved; command responsibility for disappearances and detention remains unresolved.
- `4B`: Official legislative and ECP source families recovered; direct Sharif instructions remain unestablished.
- `5B`: SIFC activity and investment-law evidence improved; distributional and execution evidence remains incomplete.
- `6B`: BISP annual-report and ADB audit leads improved; independent beneficiary outcomes remain unavailable.
- `7B`: Accountability-law chronology improved, but no personal-benefit or obstruction nexus was established.
- `8B`: SIFC project-approval evidence improved; completed outcomes and durable effectiveness remain unverified.
